Container.Name: TrialYard
Container.Overview:
A trial yard is the walled ground a smith keeps beside the forge: the place where a blade gets swung at something breakable, on purpose, before anyone carries it. A permanent, GPU-accelerated test and development sandbox on real hardware, built on Selkies for a full web desktop rather than a bare browser tab.
Exists so future testing (Selkies PR/e2e work needing a real browser and a GPU, and other ad-hoc dev/testing needs) can happen without touching production containers or the host directly.
What's inside: • Firefox and Google Chrome (cross-browser testing) • Terminal (xterm), git, curl, build-essential/gcc • Python 3 with pip, Node.js 24, Go 1.26 • Playwright's OS-level browser dependencies (install-deps). Firefox and Chrome above cover the actual browser binaries, so Playwright's own bundled-browser download is skipped to keep the image lean
GPU: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, wired with the exact pattern proven on this box's HandBrake container (--runtime=nvidia + NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES + NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES). Verify anytime with: docker exec TrialYard nvidia-smi
Resource caps (host RAM is tight with 30+ other containers running): --cpus=4 --memory=6g via Extra Parameters. This container sits idle most of the time; the cap only stops an active browser/build session from starving everything else.
WebUI opens via HTTPS on port 3001 (self-signed cert, accept it once). Auth: leave "WebUI Username" and "Password" empty to run without login.
/config is the only persistent mount. The sandbox gets no blanket access to /mnt shares, so it stays isolated from production data.

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTPS / Selkies)
Config.Description: HTTPS port of the Selkies WebUI (self-signed cert). This is the default WebUI: HTTPS is required for clipboard support in the browser. Accept the self-signed certificate once.

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTP / Selkies)
Config.Description: HTTP port of the Selkies WebUI. Optional fallback: the WebUI defaults to HTTPS (3001) because browsers only allow clipboard access over HTTPS.

Config.Name: AppData (/config)
Config.Description: Persistent desktop/dev-tool state: openbox config, Firefox/Chrome profiles, GOPATH (/config/go), npm global prefix (/config/npm-global). The only persistent mount: this sandbox does not get blanket access to /mnt shares.

Config.Name: GPU: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU(s) the NVIDIA Container Runtime exposes inside the container. 'all' matches this box's confirmed-working HandBrake/Ollama pattern. Requires --runtime=nvidia (already set in Extra Parameters).

Config.Name: GPU: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Driver capability set exposed to the container. compute,video,utility matches this box's confirmed-working HandBrake container exactly (nvidia-smi + desktop GL/zink acceleration + NVENC/NVDEC).

Config.Name: WebUI Username
Config.Description: Optional. Username for HTTP-basic-auth on the WebUI. Leave empty together with the password for no login. Set both fields to enable login (recommended outside trusted LANs).

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Optional. Password for HTTP-basic-auth on the WebUI. Leave empty together with the username for no login.

Config.Name: Keyboard Layout (KEYBOARD_LAYOUT)
Config.Description: X11 keyboard layout for the streamed desktop (e.g. us, de).

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: User-ID the desktop session runs as. Default 99 (nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for newly created files.
